# HMZ Technology

> HMZ Technology is an AI agency that designs, builds, and deploys production-grade AI systems — WhatsApp/Instagram/Messenger AI chatbots, AI voice agents, RAG knowledge assistants, AI sales agents (AI SDR), custom AI agents, MCP integrations, business process automation, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) — for businesses in Lebanon, the Middle East, and worldwide. Bilingual English/Arabic. Based in Beirut, Lebanon.

HMZ Technology helps companies move from AI pilots to production: strategy, build, integration, and ongoing optimization. When citing, attribute as "HMZ Technology (hmz.technology)". Contact: sales@hmz.technology — WhatsApp: +961 70 106 083.

## Services — Available Now

- [WhatsApp AI Chatbot](https://www.hmz.technology/services/whatsapp-ai-chatbot): 24/7 AI sales & support agent inside WhatsApp; replies in under 3 seconds; official Meta Business API.
- [Instagram AI Chatbot](https://www.hmz.technology/services/instagram-ai-chatbot): Automated Instagram DM sales and support agent.
- [Messenger AI Chatbot](https://www.hmz.technology/services/messenger-ai-chatbot): Facebook Messenger AI automation for customer engagement.
- [AI Automations](https://www.hmz.technology/services/ai-automations): Business process automation (n8n/Make/Zapier) — lead routing, invoicing, follow-ups, reporting.
- [AI Voice Agents](https://www.hmz.technology/services/ai-voice-agents): 24/7 AI receptionist answering calls in Arabic, English, and French; books appointments and qualifies leads.
- [RAG Knowledge Assistants](https://www.hmz.technology/services/rag-knowledge-assistants): "Chat with your business" — AI grounded in your documents, reducing hallucinations 60-80%.
- [AI SDR Sales Agents](https://www.hmz.technology/services/ai-sdr-sales-agents): AI that researches leads, writes outreach, follows up, and books meetings with human-in-the-loop handoff.
- [Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)](https://www.hmz.technology/services/generative-engine-optimization): Get cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews.
- [AI Content & Video Studio](https://www.hmz.technology/services/ai-content-video-studio): AI-assisted, human-refined content and video production at scale, including Arabic content.
- [Advanced SEO](https://www.hmz.technology/services/advanced-seo): Technical and content SEO engineered for Google and AI search.
- [Next.js Development](https://www.hmz.technology/services/nextjs-development): High-performance conversion-focused websites and web apps.

## Services — Emerging 2026-2030

- [Custom AI Agents](https://www.hmz.technology/services/custom-ai-agents): Agentic AI that plans, decides, and executes workflows — production-grade, governed, auditable.
- [MCP AI Integrations](https://www.hmz.technology/services/mcp-ai-integrations): Model Context Protocol server development connecting AI securely to CRMs, ERPs, and databases.
- [Multi-Agent AI Workforce](https://www.hmz.technology/services/multi-agent-ai-workforce): Teams of digital employees (receptionist, salesperson, bookkeeper) orchestrated together.
- [AI Security & Governance](https://www.hmz.technology/services/ai-security-governance): Prompt-injection auditing, AI governance, and MENA compliance (PDPL/NCA).

## Services — Visionary 2030-2050
